MKI · Jellyfin plugin

Login Showcase

An animated showcase of your library behind the Jellyfin sign-in page. Everyone who opens your Jellyfin address sees it before signing in, so it shows only artwork from the libraries you pick, up to the age rating you set.

    Look

    How the sign-in page looks. The style also decides whether posters or backdrops are sent.

    Style

    Colours
    MotionCalm moves at half speed, good for TVs left on the sign-in page. Still shows the pictures without movement; Backdrop Spotlight then changes the picture once a minute. Devices set to reduce motion always get Still.
    Puts Jellyfin's sign-in form on a glass card in the chosen colours, placed beside the artwork on large screens. Off: Jellyfin's own form on a dark panel in the middle, and no title names.
    visibility

    What visitors can see

    Only movies and shows from the libraries ticked here, with artwork stored on your server.

    LibrariesNone is ticked after installing. Libraries whose name suggests kids or adult content are marked, so they are not ticked by mistake.
    Only titles rated up to this age. Anyone can open the sign-in page, children included.
    Without a rating the limit cannot check a title, so these stay out unless you turn this on.
    Up to 48 posters and 12 backdrops. A new pick comes every hour, and right after a change here.
    Backdrop Spotlight names each title on screen. Off: pictures only.
    Flip Mosaic shows how many movies and shows of the ticked libraries the sign-in page may show.
    shield

    What the sign-in page gets

    Before anyone signs in, from the saved settings.
